title: edta_intact_ingest_v1 — manifest contract for EDTA intact-TE ingest
description: Validates POST /api/actions when type='edta_intact_ingest'. Resolves an EDTA `*.EDTA.intact.gff3` from the workspace and emits a repeat_track_intact_v0 envelope.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the EDTA intact GFF3.

subject.description: Optional tag for the assembly/haplotype these features describe (e.g. 'fClaHyb_Gar').
